question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is** "Coressponding"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the given word is** "Corresponding"**
 
• The meaning of the word is "similar to, connected with, or caused by something else"
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• Company losses were 50 percent worse than in the **corresponding **period last year.
 
 

So the correct answer is** Option 3**
